view.project-description: A fast, efficient, and user-friendly bot with numerous features for your Discord servers.
view.subtitle: TEAM BASED

main-information.long-description: ArchiTect is a versatile Discord Bot that started as a learning project and grew into a full server management tool. The bot was built and maintained by a team of five over more than a year and continuously expanded. In total, 33 slash commands were developed, including moderation features such as kick, ban, timeout and automod, a custom rank system with daily credit rewards, as well as integrations with external APIs like Reddit for memes and the Steam API for profile lookups. On the technical side, the project runs on Python with a SQL database in the background. We learned a lot about clean code, asynchronous programming and team collaboration with Git along the way.

view.project-description: Selbstgehosteter API-Server zur Fernsteuerung eines eigenen Servers — mit JWT-Auth, SSH-Tunnel-Kontrolle (UFW-Firewall via API) und Geräte-Discovery im lokalen Netzwerk. Erreichbar unter olusprogr.dynv6.net (DynDNS, nicht immer aktiv).
view.subtitle: PERSONAL PROJECT

main-information.long-description: The AI Server is a self hosted API server that lets me remotely control my own home server. It runs on Express 5 with MongoDB and is reachable via DynDNS at olusprogr.dynv6.net, although not always online. The core feature is a secure SSH tunnel control. Through a protected API endpoint I can dynamically open or close port 22 using UFW bash scripts. That way SSH does not have to stay permanently open, which significantly reduces the attack surface. Authentication runs through JWT with bcrypt hashed passwords and express rate limit, which mitigates brute force attempts. There is also a device discovery feature that pings all active devices in the local network. The frontend is an Angular 20 dashboard with Tailwind and Material Design that I am currently still building out.

challenges-solutions.challenge: Sichere Fernsteuerung eines Servers ohne den SSH-Port permanent offen zu lassen.
challenges-solutions.solution: API-Endpoint `/ssh-tunnel-auth` öffnet/schließt Port 22 dynamisch via UFW-Skripte (open-ssh-tunnel.sh, close-ssh-tunnel.sh) — geschützt durch JWT + Rate-Limit (2 Requests/Minute).
express-rate-limit pro Route: Registrierung 5/Stunde, SSH-Tunnel 2/Minute, Device-Discovery 5/Minute.

challenges-solutions.challenge: Flexibler Datenbank-Zugriff zwischen lokaler Entwicklung und produktivem Server.
challenges-solutions.solution: DatabaseService mit umschaltbarer URI (LOCAL_DB_HOST vs. DB_HOST) — wählt die Verbindung beim Serverstart.

achievements: Dynamische SSH-Port-Steuerung über UFW per API

view.project-description: Mein erstes neuronales Netz — von Grund auf mit NumPy implementiert, ohne Deep-Learning-Frameworks. Erkennt handgeschriebene Ziffern und Buchstaben (62 Klassen) aus dem EMNIST-Datensatz.
view.subtitle: PERSONAL PROJECT

main-information.thesis: Facharbeit: Grundlagen künstlicher neuronaler Netzwerke und Lernalgorithmen am Beispiel einer selbst implementierten Ziffererkennung mit Einordnung moderner Sprachmodelle (LLMs)
main-information.long-description: My first neural network, built completely from scratch in pure NumPy, without frameworks like PyTorch or TensorFlow. I wrote all the math myself, including forward pass, backpropagation, cross entropy loss and He initialization, in order to truly understand the concepts. The network recognizes handwritten digits, uppercase and lowercase letters from the EMNIST dataset, 62 classes in total. The architecture has four hidden layers with 512, 256, 128 and 64 neurons, each with ReLU activation, and a softmax output layer. Alongside the code I wrote a thesis explaining the foundations of artificial neural networks and placing modern language models like LLMs into context. Across multiple versions, a monolithic script evolved into a clean, object oriented architecture.

challenges-solutions.challenge: Mathematik eines neuronalen Netzes (Forward Pass, Backpropagation, Cross-Entropy Loss) ohne Framework verstehen und implementieren.
challenges-solutions.solution: Schrittweise Implementierung in reinem NumPy mit He-Initialisierung, Softmax-Output und Learning-Rate-Decay.

challenges-solutions.challenge: Sauberer Refactor von monolithischem Skript zu objektorientierter Architektur.
challenges-solutions.solution: Trennung in NeuralNetwork, DatasetLoader, Operations (ReLU/Softmax) und LossGUI über die Versionen v1.0 → v1.3.

achievements: Vollständig selbst implementiertes Feedforward-Netz mit 4 Hidden Layers (512→256→128→64) ohne Frameworks

versions.version-description: Monolithisches Skript mit Forward Pass, Backpropagation und Cross-Entropy Loss in reinem NumPy.
Trennung in NeuralNetwork, DatasetLoader, Operations und LossGUI; Erweiterung auf 62 Klassen (EMNIST byclass).

view.project-description: Streamlined Banking System: A Python OOP and SQL Implementation.
view.subtitle: PERSONAL PROJECT

main-information.long-description: A banking system written in Python, built to practice object oriented programming and SQL database access in one cohesive project. The system covers the basic functions of a bank: creating accounts, depositing and withdrawing money, making transfers and viewing balances. All data is persistently stored in a local SQL database. The focus was on clean class separation and a clear structure that can be easily extended later.

achievements: Added local SQL Database to the system

view.project-description: Pay2Drink is an Angular-based solution for beverage vending machines, allowing users to conveniently order and pay for their favorite drinks.
view.subtitle: TEAM BASED

main-information.long-description: Pay2Drink is a web based solution for beverage vending machines, developed as a team project during my internship at Atruvia AG. Users can register, log in, pick their drink and pay directly through an integrated payment system. The project is built with Angular on the frontend, with Angular Material and Bootstrap providing the UI. We split the work across five areas in the team: login and logout, database connection, payment system, layout and shopping cart, and credit management. For me it was the first experience working professionally in a corporate team.

view.project-description: Game Team is a team of developers and 3D-designers who create Counter Strike maps for the community. (In Cooperation with ArchiTect-Development)
view.subtitle: TEAM BASED

main-information.long-description: Game Team is a website for a developer and 3D designer crew that creates Counter Strike maps for the community. The project was built in cooperation with ArchiTect Development. The site presents our maps, introduces the team and provides an overview of recent releases. Technically, everything is built with Angular, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS. A particular challenge was making the 3D map designs look as realistic as possible, which we achieved through intensive shader work. To this day the project has gathered over 1000 downloads and we have shipped multiple map updates across versions 1.0 through 1.3.

view.subtitle: TEAM BASED

main-information.long-description: Savesphere is an affiliate marketing website focused on computer components and gaming gear. The project was built in a two person team with Levi and grew through three major version jumps. The first version was a pure frontend with a local JSON file as the data source. In version 2 we redesigned the UI from the ground up and introduced a custom logo. With version 3 came a full backend based on Express JS, which handles database operations and provides an admin control panel for managing offers. Deployment runs on Render.

view.project-description: Webbasiertes Dashboard zum Hosten und Verwalten eigener Minecraft-Server, mit JWT-basiertem Auth-System (Login nur auf Anfrage) und Live-Server-Steuerung.
view.subtitle: PERSONAL PROJECT

main-information.long-description: A web based dashboard for hosting and managing your own Minecraft servers. The project consists of two repositories: an Angular 17 frontend with server side rendering, Material Design, Tailwind and Bootstrap, plus an Express backend with MongoDB. Authentication runs through JWT tokens, passwords are hashed with bcrypt, and login is only granted on request. Inside the dashboard, users can configure, start and stop their servers and view live status. The project is currently in active development.

challenges-solutions.solution: JWT-basierte Authentifizierung mit bcrypt-Password-Hashing — Login wird nur auf Anfrage freigeschaltet.

challenges-solutions.challenge: Trennung von Frontend und Backend bei gleichzeitig konsistenter Session-Verwaltung.
challenges-solutions.solution: Separates Backend-Repository (Express + MongoDB) mit JWT-Tokens, die im Frontend persistent gehalten werden.
